notes.title: A World of Healing Awaits: Playable Demo Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I've been pouring my energy into refining the game, and I'm thrilled to share that a playable demo is on the horizon! From crafting remedies to forming meaningful connections, I want to give you a glimpse into the world I've been shaping.

My aim is to create an experience that feels immersive, rewarding, and true to my vision—a relaxing life-sim centered on healing and exploration. There's still more to fine-tune, but I can't wait for you to step into this world and begin shaping your own journey.

In the meantime, I'd love to hear your thoughts! What kinds of experiences are you most excited about? Are there specific gameplay elements you're eager to see come to life? Your feedback is invaluable as I continue shaping this adventure.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being a part of this journey!

notes.title: Nature’s Cure: Crafting Remedies & Healing Ailments
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

In this update, I want to highlight a core aspect of your role—creating remedies and treating patients. Healing isn't a one-size-fits-all process; different ailments require different approaches, and it's up to you to craft the right solution.

[h3][b]Understanding Ailments[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/6f6111c785062cdee69baa37ee0bdeb129b40f6a.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]External vs. Internal [/b]– Some ailments affect the body externally, while others require treatment from within. Each type demands a different remedy.
[*][b]Severity Matters[/b] – The seriousness of an ailment influences the treatment needed. More severe conditions require stronger remedies.
[*][b]Considering Patient Preferences[/b] – Patients have personal likes and dislikes when it comes to herbs. If you use herbs they prefer, you can administer more remedies before they need a break, allowing for more effective treatment.
[/list]

[h3][b]Crafting Remedies[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/5439a9317870c8d831769306e18df108cb77cee9.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Choosing the Right Medium[/b] – The type of remedy you create depends on the medium used, whether it's a salve, tonic, or poultice.
[*][b]Harnessing Herbal Properties[/b] – Each herb carries unique properties that transfer to the remedy. Matching similar properties can enhance potency, making it more effective for severe ailments.
[/list]

[h3][b]Managing Resources Wisely[/b][/h3]
Herbs aren’t unlimited, so careful planning is essential. Choosing which herbs to grow and using them efficiently will ensure you're always prepared to meet patient needs. Thoughtful resource management will keep your clinic stocked and ready to help those in need.


If you like what you see don't forget to Wishlist and Follow Herbal Haven!

notes.title: Greenhouses, Foraging, and Your Trusty Companion!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

It’s been about a month since the last update, so I wanted to share more details about the greenhouse, foraging for new ingredients, and your companion who will travel with you.


[h1]The Greenhouse[/h1]

The greenhouse allows you to grow various plants regardless of biome or season. Instead of the typical plant-and-harvest cycle, this system is designed to emphasize nurturing your plants. Most plants will need watering about once a week, and harvesting won’t remove them, letting you cultivate a more lasting and immersive growing experience. I wanted the greenhouse to feel like a space of care and connection with your plants.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/ce555f0c913be4b81b3bda5f51da921c37dae4f8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/ce555f0c913be4b81b3bda5f51da921c37dae4f8.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]A Living, Reactive World[/h1]

The world around you will respond dynamically to weather conditions. For example, after rainfall, mushrooms will sprout throughout the environment. On the other hand, if it hasn’t rained for a while, riverbeds may dry up—potentially revealing hidden opportunities for adventure.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/133daf79b290b7ddb18653b42df6442a0b8e129b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/133daf79b290b7ddb18653b42df6442a0b8e129b.gif[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/4007bddfa319e00d8252b1e3f135a30b42e775d8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/4007bddfa319e00d8252b1e3f135a30b42e775d8.gif[/img][/url]


[h1]Your Loyal Companion[/h1]

Your canine companion will be an invaluable part of your journey. Your four-legged friend will help sniff out plants you are searching for, making foraging a more interactive and rewarding experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45351786/e9d2a35ead1c2dc5e57663b37db267cb9a33d325.gif[/img]


Thank you for your time! If you have any questions or comments, feel free to share them below. In the next update, I’ll be diving into crafting and managing the infirmary.

See you then!


Also, if you like what you see don't forget to wishlist Herbal Haven on Steam!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364910
